$description: PantryPal color tokens. Derived from Figma y5JwIMDK9YakkOMBnSMtLz (6 frames). Merges documented in notes/analysis.md §1. 'inferred: true' = state color generated from the design language, not observed in Figma.

sources: My Recipes + Final Recipe header strips
quantity badges / check art (same hue family)
category tab bar texture (sampled fallback flat; real surface is a raster texture)
tab bar divider grooves (sampled fallback flat)

ingredient.$description: Category pastel palette (UI chips). Deliberate system: each ingredient's natural color desaturated to ~25-35% saturation at ~85-92% lightness. Use derivation rule for new ingredients.
ingredient.derivationRule: pastel = mix(naturalColor, white, 0.65) — blend the ingredient's saturated natural color 65% toward white; clamp so text.inverse stays legible on top.

state.$description: Inferred state colors — generated from the design language, NOT observed in Figma. Revisit freely.

pressedOverlay.rationale: ink-outline system: pressing darkens the sticker slightly

disabledSurface.rationale: reuse surface.steel — the file's only muted surface

error.rationale: brand.red used to double as the error hue, but at #FF4B4B it measures 2.39:1 on surface.butter and 3.30:1 on card white — both under the 4.5:1 WCAG AA floor for body text, and error copy is the text a reader can least afford to squint at (the shelf drawer's generation error and the scanner's error line both sit on butter). Darkened until it clears on every surface it can land on: 5.06:1 butter, 7.00:1 card, 6.54:1 offWhite. Same hue family, so it still reads as the app's red.
